purpose: Typed binding catalog for T12-owned fact slots. It freezes what kind of authoritative fact may satisfy each slot without inventing unfinished T11 or later-content source IDs.

T10_TRANSFORM.shipping_rule: Current IDs are hints from the accepted source only; activation-time BINDING_RESOLUTION proof decides which exact public IDs may be bound.

T11_CAMP.shipping_rule: No T11 source ID may be invented or frozen before T11 APPROVED/integrated; exact IDs must come from repository-backed activation resolution.

CONTENT_OWNER.shipping_rule: T12 freezes slot identity only. Later content owners register authoritative producers without changing the T12 level/fact-slot ID.

T12_INTERNAL.shipping_rule: These requirements shape visibility/milestone evidence only and are never eligible authoritative fact sources for t12.fact.slot.NNN.

opening_activation_contract.rule: Every activation-relevant opening-band slot is RESOLVED at T12 activation; across those rows at least one accepted T10 transform fact and at least one accepted T11 camp-state fact must be consumed. Deferred later-owner state is forbidden for these five slots.
